---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(total_home_runs = sum(HR)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = total_home_runs)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```
